title: Spec-point provenance + AO tag on every question
description: Stamp every generated question with structured metadata: { specRef, AO, bloomLevel, expectedReadingAge, sourceCitation }. Render a small 'AO1 · 4.1.1.2 · Y8 baseline' chip under each question in the teacher view (hidden in pupil view). Two wins: (a) Ofsted/department evidence falls out for free, (b) reliable analytics become possible because every question now self-describes its place on the curriculum.
rationale: User's improvement #5. The AI prompt already produces structured sections — formalise the schema so callers can rely on it. Pillar A (PR #36) added AO histograms and partial spec-ref support; this PR finishes the job and makes the data per-question, schema-validated, and visible.
steps: Audit existing schema: grep `metadata.aoHistogram`, `metadata.coverageMap`, `metadata.misconceptionLinks` in shared/aiSchemas.ts and client/src/lib/ai.ts. The per-question spec/AO data already partially exists via the coverage map (PC#10 from PR #35) — this PR formalises it into the question schema rather than only the post-validator metadata.

Extend `WorksheetQuestionSchema` in shared/aiSchemas.ts with optional fields: { specRef?: string; ao?: 'AO1'|'AO2'|'AO3'|'AO4'|'AO5'; bloomLevel?: 'remember'|'understand'|'apply'|'analyse'|'evaluate'|'create'; expectedReadingAge?: number; sourceCitation?: string }. All optional so legacy worksheets keep validating.

Update `client/src/lib/ai/generate.ts` system prompt to require the four fields above on every question. Specify the AO grade-band rules (AO1 50-60% Y7-9, AO1 30% Y10-11; AO2 30%; AO3 20%) so the model doesn't drift.
After generation, run a new post-validator `assertQuestionProvenance` (in client/src/lib/questionProvenance.ts):

- For any question missing `ao`, infer from command word + marks via the inferAo() helper that already lives in ai.ts (PR #36). Move it to a shared module so both bank-retrieval and provenance-stamp can reuse.

- For any question missing `specRef`, best-match against syllabus-data.ts using the same algorithm coverageMapBuilder.ts already runs (extract a helper). If no match within threshold, leave specRef undefined and emit a postValidatorWarning.
- For any question missing `bloomLevel`, derive from section type (already mapped in coverageMapBuilder).
- For any question missing `expectedReadingAge`, run the existing fk()/Flesch-Kincaid helper from comprehension-enhancements.ts.
- `sourceCitation` is always optional — the AI may leave it blank; warning, never error.

In WorksheetRenderer.tsx, render a small chip under each question in teacher view only: `[AO1 · 4.1.1.2 · Y8 · Bloom: apply]`. Use the existing `ws-teacher-section` class so pupil view + print + PDF respect the hide. Put the chip under a CSS class `ws-prov-chip` so accessibility profiles can override.
- client/src/lib/__tests__/questionProvenance.test.ts — covers: AO inference from command words, specRef best-match against a fixture, bloom mapping, reading-age fallback, missing-field warnings.
- WorksheetRenderer snapshot for teacher vs pupil mode confirming chip visibility.
files_to_touch: client/src/lib/ai/index.ts (re-export inferAo if it became shared)
do_not_touch: coverageMapBuilder.ts (already produces the per-question coverage table — provenance complements it)
Worksheets.tsx (pure post-validator; no UI handler change needed)
Existing prompt strings beyond the new explicit AO + spec-ref rules
acceptance_criteria: Every generated question on a Y9+ worksheet carries `ao` and `bloomLevel`. ≥80% carry `specRef` (the rest emit a postValidatorWarning).
Teacher view shows an `AO1 · 4.1.1.2 · Y8 · Bloom: apply` chip under each question; pupil view + print pupil view + PDF pupil view all hide it.
WorksheetOutputSchema validates the new fields; existing fixtures still parse (optional fields).
pnpm run check + pnpm run build + pnpm test --run pass.
verification: Manual: generate one Y10 AQA Maths worksheet and one Y8 Geography sheet; confirm chips render in teacher view, hidden in pupil view, present in printed teacher key, absent from printed pupil version.
context_budget_for_fresh_chat: MEDIUM. Read shared/aiSchemas.ts (small), the relevant 200-line range around aiGenerateWorksheet's structured-call site, and coverageMapBuilder.ts in full (~360 lines). Avoid full reads of Worksheets.tsx or ai.ts.
